Short-cropped, charcoal grey hair with a coarse texture. Small, narrow amber eyes with a serene expression. Apparent age is middle-aged with a lean, lithe, and highly flexible build. Wears a traditional saffron-orange dhoti and a matching wrap around the chest. Signature details include a small gold hoop earring in the left ear and a long, thin, charcoal grey tail.
BODY COLOR: charcoal grey
